caseName: Laguerra v. Merit Sys. Prot. Bd.
caseNameFull: Margaret A. LAGUERRA v. MERIT SYSTEMS PROTECTION BOARD.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperisdenied. Petitioner allowed until November 24, 2014, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
